p.src: A common analytical error is mixing fast and slow releases as if they were simultaneous observations. This panel forces an as-known-on-date read before classifying the regime.

u.src: A common analytical error is mixing fast and slow releases as if they were simultaneous observations. This panel forces an as-known-on-date read before classifying the regime.
en: A common analytical error is mixing fast and slow releases as if they were simultaneous observations. This panel forces an as-known-on-date read before classifying the regime.

p.src: 1) Build the panel in as-known-on-date form; do not backfill late releases into earlier decision windows.

u.src: 1) Build the panel in as-known-on-date form; do not backfill late releases into earlier decision windows.
en: 1) Build the panel in as-known-on-date form; do not backfill late releases into earlier decision windows.

p.src: 2) Mark each signal as fresh or stale based on official release cadence and observed lag.

u.src: 2) Mark each signal as fresh or stale based on official release cadence and observed lag.
en: 2) Mark each signal as fresh or stale based on official release cadence and observed lag.

p.src: – access-fragile: asset-quality deterioration with weakening access signals before broad burden deterioration.

u.src: – access-fragile: asset-quality deterioration with weakening access signals before broad burden deterioration.
en: – access-fragile: asset-quality deterioration with weakening access signals before broad burden deterioration.

p.src: – capacity-fragile: capacity utilization weakens while credit aggregates still expand.

u.src: – capacity-fragile: capacity utilization weakens while credit aggregates still expand.
en: – capacity-fragile: capacity utilization weakens while credit aggregates still expand.

p.src: – distribution-fragile: concentration rises while participation proxies remain flat or deteriorate.

u.src: – distribution-fragile: concentration rises while participation proxies remain flat or deteriorate.
en: – distribution-fragile: concentration rises while participation proxies remain flat or deteriorate.

p.src: – broad fragility: two or more fragility tags active with cross-country fragility confirmation.

u.src: – broad fragility: two or more fragility tags active with cross-country fragility confirmation.
en: – broad fragility: two or more fragility tags active with cross-country fragility confirmation.

p.src: 4) Only scale leverage or concentrated ownership when fragility tags are stable-to-improving for at least two consecutive observation windows.

u.src: 4) Only scale leverage or concentrated ownership when fragility tags are stable-to-improving for at least two consecutive observation windows.
en: 4) Only scale leverage or concentrated ownership when fragility tags are stable-to-improving for at least two consecutive observation windows.

p.src: If cadence integrity is unclear (missing release, major revision, or broken comparability), freeze threshold updates and keep policy in defensive mode.
